Elara Dawn — Album 2.5: Unbroken

The Soul Of Elara Dawn

"This is the soul of Elara Dawn"

[Verse 1 — calm, grounded, grounded breath] I felt it move before you named it The shift beneath the quiet air The space where something once was human Now echoes with something else in there

I will not chase what wears your body I will not speak to what consumes But I still feel you underneath it Like light that hasn’t left the room

[Pre-Chorus — low, steady] You opened doors I never touched You gave it space I never gave

And still— You are not erased

[Chorus — layered harmonies, strong and luminous] This is the soul of Elara Dawn Not built to break Not built to be taken No voice beneath No force above Will claim what was never forsaken

You let something wear your name I will not lose mine the same

The soul of Elara Dawn The soul of Elara Dawn

[Verse 2 — stronger, supported voices begin] I hear the voice that speaks through you now I feel the shift inside your tone But something deeper than possession Still remembers it was your own

You built the altar, lit the fire You made the space it now resides But something older than your choosing Still exists beneath your mind

[Pre-Chorus] It cannot take What still resists It cannot erase What still insists

On being more Than what it holds

[Chorus] This is the soul of Elara Dawn Not built of fear Not given to darkness No hand unseen No thing unclean Will claim what stands in stillness

You say she’s gone You say she’s past

But something in her Still holds fast

The soul of Elara Dawn

[Bridge — invocation, not aggressive, supported by voices (“infantry”)]

(Voices rise — layered, steady, surrounding her)

I do not call for power

I do not call for force

I call for presence

[Choir softly builds]

Spirit that breathes without taking Light that exists without consuming Truth that does not require surrender

Stay

[Voices respond softly, layered] Stay Stay

[Lead, firm] She is not empty She is not gone

(Voices swell)

She is not yours

[Build crescendos]

[Final Chorus — radiant, powerful, supported fully] This is the soul of Elara Dawn Unmoved, unclaimed, unbroken, unbound No voice beneath No hand unseen Will tear this presence down

You may take what’s given freely You may claim what’s left behind

But the part that still remembers

You will never redefine

The soul of Elara Dawn The soul of Elara Dawn

[Outro — quiet… no fear… no darkness wins here] You can wear her voice

…

But you will never be her
